column3: Read-only audit of existing AdFox source ledgers and derived artifacts against the historical ask's per-observation URL, retrieval timestamp, query/profile conditions, field names, and raw-response-hash contract; publish only a redacted integrity/completeness manifest, with no new collection and no raw rows or identifiers in shared output.

After the evidence manifest, decide whether the historical ask is already satisfied; close as no-new-collection if so, or write a bounded, provenance/privacy/coverage-gated successor design for any material gap. Do not collect traffic in this step.
